Predict Ligand Activities (C++ Implementation)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
predict_ligand_activities_cpp.Rd

Computes ligand activity metrics for all ligands simultaneously.

Usage

predict_ligand_activities_cpp(
  target_genes,
  gene_names,
  ligand_target_matrix,
  ligand_names
)

Arguments

target_genes

Character vector of target gene symbols

gene_names

Character vector of all gene names (matrix rownames)

ligand_target_matrix

Numeric matrix of ligand-target scores (genes x ligands)

ligand_names

Character vector of ligand names (matrix colnames)

Value

DataFrame with columns: test_ligand, auroc, aupr, aupr_corrected, pearson

Details

For each ligand, computes: - AUROC: Area under ROC curve for target gene prediction - AUPR: Area under Precision-Recall curve - AUPR corrected: AUPR minus random baseline - Pearson: Correlation between ligand-target scores and target membership
